items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: I met his people, you know, all his people. ... when she married this boy, what's his name again? Herbie.

ctx.x: Well, to get back to us, tell me, what about Herbie Friedwald's wedding? What was that like?

Well, I tell you. It was a nice wedding. Really was nice, and I met his people, you know, all his people. I met this girl, his wife, people, you know, very nice people. They were all nice, you know what I mean? So, the funnest thing about it, his wife, you know, she, after she had a wedding, you know, she was there in the place, you know, she pulled up, she said, ooh, Lord, your shoes killing me. She took her shoes off. I said, oh, Lord, I think you ain't gonna take your shoes off in the middle part of your…
